text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One major problem is bias. AI systems can make unfair decisions if the data they learn from is not balanced. This can harm certain groups of people. Fairness means that AI should treat everyone equally. Privacy is also a serious concern, because AI often collects personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it safely. Transparency matters too: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means that companies and governments must work together to create clear rules and make sure AI helps society rather than hurts it.
